items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I went to the musician local, saw friends around there, the president, Harry Gray and Samuel Mitchell

ctx.x: Did you play out there at all?

No, I just, I didn't take no instrument either, because I went out there to bury my sister, but I went around to those places. Mm-hmm. And I passed through Chicago, coming back, around about, uh, oh, yeah, that was around September, yeah. I stayed around there about ten days, and I went to the musician local, saw friends around there, the president, Harry Gray and Samuel Mitchell, uh, recording secretary, I believe. Mm-hmm. And, uh, when I came back here, the group I was working was still working at the Offshore…
Mm-hmm. That was the Jim Davis?
